inputs.note: settled revenue 100, compute expense 30, external fees 5, no internal transfers

exceptions.name: missing-evidence
exceptions.rule: A receipt whose inputs lack a price for a material position has result kind insufficient-evidence and lists the position under inputs.missing; it never values the position at zero.

exceptions.name: boundary-change
exceptions.rule: A receipt recorded for version 1 of a Unit is not returned as a valuation of version 2; assertions are kept per (unitId, version) and assertionCount(unitId, 2) does not include it.

exceptions.name: internal-transfer
exceptions.rule: A payment between two elements of the same Unit that crosses no port is not inflow or outflow of the Unit; the realized net cash flow attributable to it is 0.
exceptions.example: examples/swarm-unit.json (relation exchanges between the two sub-units)

exceptions.name: shared-right
exceptions.rule: A skill included by two child Units with share 1/2 each is counted once at the parent level by the net-equity method.

exceptions.name: expired-or-revoked
exceptions.rule: An assertion past validUntil, revoked or superseded is returned only when marked as such and is never presented as current.

exceptions.name: unsupported-extension
exceptions.rule: A document with an extension member marked required whose identifier the consumer does not know is reported as unsupported.

exceptions.name: overlap-under-different-references
exceptions.rule: Two positions with different element ids but the same underlying are one claim group only when a same-claim relation with a basis links them; then the net-equity method counts the entitlement once (45.12). Without a same-claim or distinct-claim declaration the overlap is unresolved and no point monetary value is admissible: the receipt is an interval (low 45.12 counted once, high 90.24 counted separately) or insufficient-evidence listing the pair under inputs.overlaps.

exceptions.name: withdrawn-evidence
exceptions.rule: O -> V -> revoke(O): observer X records observation O, evaluator Y records receipt V citing O (snapshot.observations, snapshot.hash), X revokes O. O is revoked and not current; V keeps status active (X cannot revoke or supersede V; the assertion count is unchanged); a resolver presents V with evidence status withdrawn, lists O as revoked, and does not present V as current. Contrast: receipt V2 cites observation O2 whose validity window ends after V2's as-of time; after the window ends, O2 is not current but V2's evidence status is supported and V2 is current. Had O2's window ended before the as-of time, the evidence status would be expired and V2 would still be returned as current.

sequence.action: assertStatement(kind valuation) -> V, content cites O in snapshot.observations and carries snapshot.hash = contentHash(O)

reverts: an assertion by X with supersedes = V: AUF_SupersedeMismatch

sequence.action: supersede(V) with a corrected receipt or one of kind insufficient-evidence (expected, not required)
